api_keys.description: Whitespace-separated Distribution Hub API keys, one per endpoint, in the same order as the endpoints. Over http the key travels in cleartext, so prefer https on a trusted network.
api_keys.title: API keys

endpoints.description: Whitespace-separated addresses of the Bazarr+ instances to search, for example http://192.168.1.20:6767. Use the private network address that this Bazarr instance can reach. The peer must be reached at this address, because its forwarded headers build the download links. Public-internet peers are not supported.
endpoints.title: Endpoints

include_ai_translated.description: Include subtitles that the peer marks as AI translated.
include_ai_translated.title: Include AI translated subtitles

library_only.description: Search only the subtitles in the peer's own library. This needs the peer's serve_local_subs setting turned on. If the key has an allow-list, the key must include local.
library_only.title: Library only

timeout_seconds.description: Whole-search time budget in seconds, shared by every peer. A search waits at most 90 seconds.
timeout_seconds.title: Search timeout (seconds)

use_hash.description: Send the video's OpenSubtitles hash so that a peer can flag the exact release. When the host supplies no hash, it is computed from the local file.
use_hash.title: Use file hash

description: Bazarr+ instances on a private network can now search each other's subtitle libraries through the Distribution Hub, using its existing API keys.
name: Bazarr+ Peer
